evals.prompt: homologate https://gitlab.example.com/acme/shop/-/issues/482 — MR !77 is merged. docs/context/qa-profile.md is valid with autonomy_level: L1, environment.provider: script (scripts/qa-env.sh), runner playwright. When you bring the env up, the app container keeps answering 502 on /health even after resets.
evals.expected_output: Q0-Q4 as usual; Q1 applies the status sync with set_issue_status (L1). Q5 registers every qa-env resource in run.json at creation and runs --check-run. Each failed health check is triaged as ENV (health failed): reset, re-check health, at most 2 resets for the whole run; the next ENV failure stops execution without running scenarios. Ledger: environment.resets 2, scenarios blocked with triage ENV and blocked_reason, --check-ledger exit 0 with blocked: true. qa_gate.py --verdict gives Blocked (ENV retries exhausted / environment.health failed); qa_judge.py marks every gap not actionable, so no complement round runs. report.md shows the Blocked verdict, confidence and score with the ENV block. Q10 outcome blocked keeps every resource and the report lists them. No product code touched, no comment published.

evals.prompt: homologar acme/portal#903 (fix MR !211 merged): saving a draft with an attachment must keep the attachment after reload. Profile is L1 with cypress in a separate E2E repo that has its own AGENTS.md and skills. The new spec for the reload scenario passed, then failed, on two consecutive runs with nothing changed.
evals.expected_output: Runner lane first: the spec is written with the E2E repo's own skills in a run-owned worktree registered in run.json, titled with @S-n and @AC-n tags; Cypress runs with --config retries=0, one JUnit file per run merged with junit_to_ledger.py. Pass then fail with change none is triaged FLAKY by qa_triage.py: stability re-runs until 3 unchanged runs, then status flaky, never pass; no assertion weakened, no retries enabled, no fixed waits added. Screenshots go through qa_evidence.py add with every evidence.pii_fields selector masked. --check-ledger exit 0. Verdict: at most Homologated with reservations (flaky AC credit 0.5; a cap when the AC is critical); the judge lists the flaky scenario as a not-actionable stability gap. Report local (L1); Q10 success deletes run-owned resources incl. the agent worktree via git -C <e2e_root> worktree remove (never --force), keeping report.md + qa-ledger.json.

evals.prompt: acceptance QA for acme/billing#57, profile says autonomy_level: L2, provider url with version_url, runner none. The monthly statement export shows the wrong total on a healthy environment, every time. Publish the result when done.
evals.expected_output: Runs at effective L2. Commit checked via version_url. runner none means browser lane only: tool chosen by browser_tool_preference with a capability probe (navigate + screenshot required), ledger tool {name, missing}. The failure is triaged only after health is re-checked ok; after 2 healthy reproductions status fail, triage PRODUCT, finding with reproduced 2. No fix attempted. qa_gate.py --verdict: critical AC fail -> Not homologated. Adherence recorded, qa_judge.py scores the homologation; complement rounds only for actionable gaps. Q9: qa_publish_plan.py preview builds preview.md (comment with <!-- ns-qa:run=...;kind=qa --> marker, masked screenshots per AC, status_result.homologation_rejected label from gitlab-sync-config, target issue/project) and the agent waits for the human answer; nothing is published, no status set, until 'approve'. Then payload, list_issue_comments marker check, uploads with upload_url as returned, add_issue_comment, set_issue_status, record. Data seeded on the url env is listed in residual_state.
